dedupe_keys.name: six month scada monitoring data set from a 10 turbine onshore wind farm in greece underpin sample

description: This data set gives six months of supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) records, from 1 January to 30 June 2020, from a 10-turbine onshore wind farm in Greece. It was published on Zenodo in December 2024 by Aristotelis Ntafalias, Sofia Visvardi and Axel Weißenfeld as a sample of wind turbine generator data from the data space of the EU UNDERPIN project. Operational logs include variables such as generator speed and bearing temperature and flag extreme wind directions, and alarm and event logs record operational problems and turbine performance. Coverage is one wind farm in Greece, whose exact location is not given. The data are one Excel workbook of about 180 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: only six months and one site are covered, and the turbine model and farm location are not documented in the abstract. Simulation uses are fault detection and predictive maintenance models, alarm analysis and wind turbine reliability studies. Related records: data-kelmarsh-wind-farm-scada and data-care-to-compare-wind-turbine-scada-anomalies are other open wind SCADA data sets.
